findings.title: 顶层 5 个 config/summary shim:生产已迁走、仅 53 处测试经它进、被 SP05 钉死为冻结兼容面
findings.reference_chain: 5 个 shim 各 6-30 行,纯 from .config.X / .summary.X 转出。grep 生产 importer(排除 tests):0——生产一律走深路径 .config.config_service / .summary.schedule_summary,或经 scheduler/__init__.py:21 __getattr__ 映射到 .config.config_service;web 侧 web/error_boundary.py:104、scheduler_config.py:11 等也走 core.services.scheduler.config / scheduler import ConfigService(__init__ 收口),无人走顶层 shim。grep 测试 importer:53 处 from core.services.scheduler.config_service/schedule_summary import …。钉死点:tests/test_sp05_path_topology_contract.py:20-31 SERVICE_BEHAVIOR_COMPAT_SYMBOLS 把这 5 个列为'behavior-compat 别名',:300-339 断言旧模块 __all__ 与符号 is 新模块,且 PRODUCTION_LEGACY_IMPORT_SCAN_ROOTS(:135)禁止 core/web 生产代码 import 它们。
findings.why_debt: config→config/、summary→summary/ 包拆分(地基体检记载的'主病=半截迁移')留下的兼容尾巴:生产已全量迁到深路径,旧顶层路径只作为冻结兼容面保留,真实外部消费者=0(只有未迁移的 53 个测试还在经它进)。属典型迁移残渣,只是被 SP05 锁住不会悄悄烂。
findings.blast_radius: 误删任一 shim:破 test_sp05_path_topology_contract + 53 个 test 的 import。但这些测试是自指的(测兼容面本身/尚未迁移),非真实外部脚本。怀疑者需裁决:保留一个只有测试在用的冻结兼容层是承重(防某离线脚本 import 旧路径)还是纯仪式残渣——若确认无外部消费者,应连同 53 测试一起迁到深路径再删 shim。
findings._adv_precondition: 它不是承重安全护栏(纯转出,删了只会响亮 ImportError,不破任何安全不变量),本质=半截迁移的冻结兼容残渣,可收;但普查"0生产/纯自指测试"的证据是错的,故不能直接 rm。动它前必须: (1) 把两个非测试在用消费者迁到深路径——tools/capture_networkx_phase0_baseline.py:17 与 audit/2026-03/20260316_schedule_audit_probes.py:87 改为 .config.config_service / .summary.schedule_summary; (2) 重指 53 处测试 import 到深路径; (3) 从 test_sp05_path_topology_contract.py 的 SERVICE_BEHAVIOR_COMPAT_SYMBOLS/PUBLIC_SYMBOLS(:20-82)删这 5 条并改文档树断言(:642-658 期望 config_service.py 标注"兼容薄门面")。三步做完再删 shim。SP05 冻结是有意决定,删除是一次需协调的迁移而非自由删除。
_adv_evidence: core/services/scheduler/config_service.py:1-5 (+config_snapshot.py/config_validator.py/schedule_summary.py:1-29/schedule_summary_types.py): all 5 verified pure re-export, 0 logic lines — no fallback/validation/version-gate. Deleting removes zero behavior; the only failure mode is a loud ImportError, which honors the soul line rather than breaking any safety invariant (no preview-as-official / stale-version / swallowed-bad-data / cross-layer). Therefore NOT a load-bearing safety guardrail.

Production bypasses the shims entirely: web/error_boundary.py:104 + scheduler_config_display_state.py:5 -> '.config'; scheduler_config.py:11 / personnel_calendar_pages.py:7 -> scheduler/__init__.py:19,34-40 __getattr__ mapping 'ConfigService' to '.config.config_service'; schedule_service.py:259 -> '.config.config_service'. No production importer hits the top-level shim.

CENSUS EVIDENCE CORRECTION — not '0 production / only 53 self-referential tests'. Two LIVE non-test consumers exist on the old path: tools/capture_networkx_phase0_baseline.py:17 ('from core.services.scheduler.config_service import ConfigService'; also the ONLY rev_dep in rev_deps.json for the config_service shim) and audit/2026-03/20260316_schedule_audit_probes.py:87 ('from core.services.scheduler.schedule_summary import build_overdue_items'). Both are offline operational/diagnostic scripts OUTSIDE SP05 scan roots (core, web) — exactly the 'offline script on old path' the arbitration worried about. So it is not pure test ceremony; deletion as-is breaks real tooling.

SP05 is the governance guard pinning the shim, not the shim itself: tests/test_sp05_path_topology_contract.py:20-31 lists all 5 as behavior-compat aliases; :329-337 asserts old.__all__ == expected and getattr(old,sym) IS getattr(new,sym) (shared identity -> no isinstance/dual-class hazard); :390-399 forbids core/web production growth; :642-658 expects config_service.py documented as '兼容薄门面'. A unilateral delete breaks this contract test plus 53 test imports.

Soul-line check (foundation invariant): breakage on delete is a loud ImportError, never a silent bad-data fallback or version masquerade — confirms the shim guards no safety invariant; the system fails loudly with or without it.

findings.title: batch_service._safe_float 重造浮点解析并静默吞错,绕过 parse_finite_float
findings.reference_chain: _safe_float:value 为 None/空串 return None,否则 try float(value) except Exception: return None——坏值悄悄变 None,不抛不记。这绕过了收口点 core/shared/number_utils.py:23 parse_finite_float(会 raise ValidationError 并校验有限性)。消费点:batch_template_ops.py:172 'ext_days': svc._safe_float(tmpl.ext_days)、batch_copy.py:72 'ext_days': svc._safe_float(op.ext_days)。但 ext_days 来源已被严格校验:core/models/batch_operation.py:92 ext_days=parse_optional_float(ext_days, field='ext_days')、part_operation.py:75 同理——即模型加载时已是合法 float/None,_safe_float 看到的几乎不可能是坏值。tests/test_architecture_fitness.py:77 已把 batch_service.py:_safe_float 列入 LOCAL_PARSE_HELPER_ALLOWLIST。
findings.why_debt: 同一概念(浮点解析)的私有第 N 套实现 + 静默兜底死角:理论上若 ext_days 是坏值会被悄悄吞成 None 而非暴露,违背不自欺原则。但因上游模型已严格解析,实际是冗余防御;且已被 fitness 注册表显式 allowlist 承认。
findings.blast_radius: 极小。替换为 parse_finite_float 仅在 ext_days 真为坏值时改变行为(从静默 None→抛 ValidationError,反而更符合灵魂原则);但因上游已校验,几乎触发不到。需先核对模板/复制路径是否真要拒绝坏 ext_days 再动,且需同步移除 allowlist 条目。
